discovery.scope: Broad search plus author follow-up, bounded to this collection session; not an exhaustive index of X.

provenance.postMetadata: Public X pages and FxTwitter public post JSON
provenance.publicationCheck: Source timestamp cross-checked against X Snowflake ID to within 2 seconds
provenance.modelAttribution: Creator-reported; context links or visible comparison labels are retained where needed. No independent generation-process audit.
provenance.promptPolicy: Verbatim public prompts only. Missing prompts are explicitly labelled. Older referenced prompts are allowed, while every included video source post must pass the cutoff.
provenance.mediaValidation: ffprobe, full ffmpeg decode, visual frame review, SHA-256 duplicate checks, followed by public CDN hash readback and HTTP range verification.

curationPolicy.screening: Review directly on X, including substantive comments and visible engagement, before downloading final selections.
